title: Stop Overthinking: A Survey on Efficient Reasoning for Large Language Models
best_for_zh: 比较推理过程、预算与评测方法的读者。
one_line: A TMLR survey of how to reduce redundant reasoning without treating trace length as the only goal.
从模型、输出与提示三层整理高效推理的 TMLR 2025 综述。
why: It links trace data, adaptive budgets, and evaluation rather than treating efficiency as mere token reduction.
inclusion_reason: A TMLR 2025 survey from Rice University and University of Houston that directly covers reasoning traces, efficient training data, and evaluation.

title: Problem
问题
html: Long chain-of-thought can improve difficult reasoning, yet it often produces repeated or unnecessary text. This survey asks how a system can spend less computation without removing the steps that make hard answers correct. Its objects are prompts, reasoning traces, final answers, and efficiency measurements. The lesson is to distinguish genuine deliberation from visible length.
长思维链能提升难题推理，却也常生成重复或不必要的文本。该综述追问：系统如何少花计算，又不删掉让难题答对的步骤？它关注提示、推理过程、最终答案和效率测量。核心是区分真正的深思与可见长度。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html: The paper separates three intervention points: change the reasoning model, change the emitted reasoning process, or adapt the prompt and budget to the input. Compare all three against both answer quality and cost. A shorter trace is useful only when it preserves the evidence needed by the task.
论文分出三个干预位置：改变推理模型、改变输出的推理过程，或按输入调整提示与预算。三者都要同时比较答案质量和成本。只有保留任务所需证据时，更短过程才有价值。

title: Method
方法
html: This is a literature taxonomy rather than a new training pipeline. For each method, record the input difficulty signal, trace representation, budget rule, model and decoding setup, final metric, and cost metric. That record reveals whether a claimed gain comes from better learned behavior, early stopping, or a changed test condition.
这是一份文献分类，不是新的训练流水线。对每种方法记录输入难度信号、过程表示、预算规则、模型与解码设置、最终指标和成本指标。这样可判断提升来自更好的已学行为、提前停止，还是测试条件改变。

title: Evidence
证据
html: The official abstract identifies model-based, output-based, and prompt-based efficient reasoning, and also covers efficient data, small models, and benchmarks. The survey is therefore a map for choosing a primary study. It is not a single leaderboard: task mix, hardware, and budget definitions remain important.
官方摘要列出模型、输出和提示三类高效推理，并覆盖高效数据、小模型与基准。因此它适合用作寻找原始研究的地图，而不是统一排行榜：任务构成、硬件和预算定义仍然关键。

title: Novelty
新意
html: The novelty is a reasoning-specific view of efficiency. Earlier serving work mainly optimized generic generation; this survey focuses on deliberate traces and the overthinking failure mode. It makes trace quality, data, and adaptive computation part of the same comparison.
新意是从推理特性出发看效率。较早的服务研究主要优化一般生成；该综述聚焦深思过程和过度思考失败，使过程质量、数据和自适应计算进入同一比较框架。

title: Limitations
局限
html: Tokens, time, energy, and accuracy are different quantities. A hidden or compressed process may lower visible cost while reducing inspectability, and a fixed small budget can fail precisely on the rare problems that need exploration. Check difficulty-stratified results before reusing an efficiency claim.
token、时间、能耗和准确率是不同量。隐藏或压缩过程可能降低可见成本，却削弱可检查性；固定小预算可能恰好在少数需要探索的问题上失败。复用效率主张前，应检查按难度分层的结果。

title: Usefulness
用途
html: Use this paper when a trace-producing system has a real latency or cost limit. Define the answer-quality floor first, then select a budget rule and measurements. It helps prevent a common mistake: optimizing average trace length before checking whether removed steps carry the information that avoids an error.
当会输出推理过程的系统有真实延迟或成本限制时，可用这篇论文。先定义答案质量下限，再选择预算规则和测量。它能避免常见错误：先优化平均过程长度，却不检查被删步骤是否承载避免错误的信息。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html: Read the three method families as a comparison table. For every candidate, write quality signal, cost signal, intervention point, and the hardest failure. Keep quality and cost separate until the end; otherwise an attractive average can hide a severe loss on difficult reasoning.
把三类方法读成比较表。对每个候选记录质量信号、成本信号、干预位置和最难失败。直到最后都分开保存质量与成本，避免漂亮平均数掩盖难题上的严重损失。
